name: Jalingo

queries.query: Jalingo Taraba cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Taraba Geographic Information Service (TAGIS), a Jalingo-based state government GIS and digital land-administration custodian. Its public site describes cadastral mapping and land registration, but no anonymous parcel viewer or geometry endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: Jalingo bayanan filaye taswirar kadastare hukuma
queries.result: The Hausa-language discovery route did not expose a first-party public parcel viewer or downloadable parcel geometry. Results still pointed to the official TAGIS custodian and general government land-service context; no geometry claim is made.

researchNote: TAGIS is evidenced as the local/state registry and cadastral custodian for Jalingo/Taraba. The packet records service discovery only; no parcel polygon was retained because anonymous public geometry access was not found. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence and is not source integration or runtime admission.
